description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Meta Llama 3.2 1B, the smallest and cheapest model here, for routing, tagging and quick rewrites (60K context). Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agentrxi.com/v1/llama1b and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.081 per million input and $0.603 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0059. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (streaming supported), up to 4096 output tokens. Costs $0.0059 USDC per call (x402).
name: llama1b_chat_completions
